publication issues.summary: Status: converted with findings; private, partial and unapproved, not installed. Scope, model, text, native TIFF, converter, renderer, schema and installation receipt were authenticated to scope pins before restoration or conversion. Bootstrap.json records deterministic Page.raw restoration and model/text equality; raw is not an independent acquisition. Baseline review was partial, source reviewed, wiring partial, user approval false. No source edits were made. Candidate is the baseline inputs, so source raw/model/text diffs and inverses are empty and complements identical; no source re-fit needed. Actual authenticated converter command, cwd, exit, stdout and stderr are preserved in Converter invocation.json and logs. It emitted 36 blocks, 100 terminals, 54 nets, six uncertainties and one format question, with 280 unresolved differences including five wiring glyph discrepancies. Report lists only first 200 of its detailed differences; Difference inventory.json derives all 280 positions directly from source and emitted text. V4 review content digest e875fbaa6cd102c8a26e87a70e1f015cdd3dbfeec44120bd40826c5a1522db8d matches canonical JSON excluding review. The pinned renderer load verifies this digest and, using recorded CRLF/no trim writer options, re-renders exact emitted TXT. Full external schema NOT_RUN. Native overview and all 12 overlapping tiles were viewed. All 311 sectional route panels and 77 junction/unjoined point panels were viewed as attempted overlays, plus 31 grouped windows containing all 280 renderer-difference cells. These are not proof of route completeness or electrical connectivity. Block-fit registration is untrusted: 39/72 inliers, median 1.54 render pixels, below 60% criterion. Independent edge registration attempt failed affine fit (AssertionError); manual seed is not evidence. Red-blue residuals materially displace crossings, and selected panels around columns 44, 65, 89, 113 and 153 cannot resolve geometric correspondence. No conclusion or corrective changes were made from intersection, symbols or discrepancy.
